title: Short videos for your business
description: Pick what the video is for, NIVO writes the script, you edit it, then it is rendered for TikTok, Reels, Zalo or Facebook.
loadFailedTitle: The video workbench could not be loaded
loadFailedBody: The data may not be ready yet. Try again in a moment.
viewOnly: You can look but not change anything. Owner or manager access is needed to make videos.
libraryEmptyBody: Press New video. You pick the goal, NIVO writes the script and renders it.
titleHint: Only for you, to find it later.
sourcesHint: Public knowledge only: a video is seen by customers.
sourcesEmpty: No public knowledge yet. Add it on the Knowledge page and set it to Public.
notesLabel: What do you want to stress?
notesHint: For example: the offer ends on Sunday, or call us before booking.
mediaHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, MP4, MOV or WebM, up to 50 MB each.
mediaEmpty: No photos or clips yet. Scenes without one use a card in your brand colours.
mediaUse: Offer this file to the script
rewriteWarn: Writing again replaces the scenes below.
scripting: NIVO is writing the script. This usually takes 20 to 60 seconds.
mediaPick: Photo or clip for this scene
scriptEmpty: No script yet. Let NIVO write one, or add scenes yourself.
tooLong: Too long: a video is at most 90 seconds.
storyboardHint: A first look. The finished video adds the voice, music and captions.
renderNote: Rendering takes about 1 to 3 minutes. You can leave this page; it keeps going.
approveHelp: Watch it first. NIVO never posts by itself: after you approve, you download or send it.
share: Send me the link in Office
postNote: NIVO cannot post for you yet. You download the file and post it yourself.
approvedLocked: Editing makes this video a draft again and needs a new approval.
brandHint: Name, colours, logo, music and voice used in every video.
